annotations.title: Change custom product pages and A/B tests

description: One change to the App Store's custom product pages or A/B tests (needs a token allowed to submit). action and body: page.create { name, template: "listing" (a copy of the live product page, the default) | "blank" (with locale and promotionalText) | "page:<pageId>" }; page.update { pageId, name?, visible? }; page.text { pageId, locale, promotionalText } (170 characters; a new locale adds that language); page.newVersion { pageId } (to change an approved page); page.remove { pageId }; page.review { pageId }; test.create { name, trafficProportion (percent of visitors who see a treatment, 1-100), treatments: [{ name, appIconName? }] (1 to 3; icons from ploa_marketing_get options) }; test.update { testId, name?, trafficProportion? }; test.treatment { testId, treatmentId? (leave out to add), name, appIconName? }; test.treatmentRemove { testId, treatmentId }; test.locale { testId, treatmentId, locale } (then upload its screenshots); test.remove { testId }; test.review { testId }; test.start { testId } (once App Review approved it); test.stop { testId } (it can't start again); media.remove { owner: page|test, parentId, localizationId, kind: screenshot|preview, id }; media.order { owner, parentId, localizationId, kind, setId, ids }. From an agent, page.review, test.review, test.start and test.stop wait for a person's approval; removing a page people saw, or a test that ran, is a person's.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
